exposure: Assisted reproductive technology (ART) conception (IVF or ICSI)
cohort: 14,415 deliveries at two university tertiary care obstetric units, narrowed down to 1356 uncomplicated singleton term pregnancies (188 ART, 1168 spontaneous conception)
finding: Uncomplicated term pregnancies conceived through ART had a higher risk of operative delivery, retained placenta, and PPH compared to spontaneous conceptions.
mod_finding: Women with uncomplicated term pregnancies conceived through assisted reproductive technology had a higher risk of operative delivery, retained placenta, and postpartum hemorrhage compared to those with spontaneous conceptions.
birth_weight: Mentioned, but specific values not provided
